rule: InvoiceNo, StockCode to text; CustomerID to nullable integer
trim Description and collapse repeated spaces
reason: stops one name being treated as several values; wording is not altered

rule: rename EIRE, RSA, USA; add CountryISO2 (blank when no single country is given)
reason: standard names and codes allow joins with external data; responds to the FAIR vocabulary gap
identical in every field; would inflate quantity and revenue

rule: move 'C' invoices for real products to returns file (RecordType = product cancellation)
reason: valid business events, but reversals rather than sales

rule: move 'C' invoices on administrative codes to returns file (RecordType = administrative reversal)
reason: non-product codes: postage, fees and discounts are not goods, and the content of manual entries is unknown

rule: move Quantity < 0 without 'C' invoice to returns file
reason: all have price 0 and no customer; notes such as 'damaged' indicate warehouse corrections
all have price 0 and no customer: internal entries, not sales
no sale value: stock notes, bad-debt entries and some free items; free items recoverable from excluded file
postage, fees, discounts and vouchers are not products

rule: flag sales with an exact one-to-one cancellation (LaterCancelled)
reason: lets analysts exclude reversed sales; gross revenue is otherwise overstated

rule: remove sales with Quantity >= 10,000 that were fully cancelled
reason: not real demand; other large orders are kept because many customers are wholesalers

rule: add HasCustomerID and LineRevenue (no rows removed)
reason: missingness is systematic; removing it would lose about 25% of sales and bias product analysis
